name: Deore XT 180 mm six-bolt disc rotor
weight_description: Manufacturer-listed 156 g for one SM-RT75MA 180 mm six-bolt rotor, including the fixing bolts. The table explicitly labels its rotor weights as with fixing bolts. This is the 180 mm MA unit; no weight is transferred to the distinct 160 mm or 170 mm rotor references.
